title: Counterfactual Tests for Measuring Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness in Visual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) may often look plausible, yet it may not faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. While methods for measuring the faithfulness of CoTs for textual inputs have been increasingly introduced, using these methods for visual inputs is not straightforward. In this work, we adapt the family of counterfactual methods for measuring CoT faithfulness, namely the Counterfactual Test (CT) and Correlational Counterfactual Test (CCT), to visual inputs, and call them vCT and vCCT, respectively. Using vCT and vCCT, we benchmark eight recent open-source Vision Language Models (VLMs) on two datasets. Our analysis shows that CoTs do not reliably track visual evidence that influences model predictions: they may omit the removed object even when its removal causes a large prediction shift, yet mention it when the shift is small. We further find that Predict-then-Explain explanations align more strongly with perturbation

translated_title: 用于测量视觉语言模型中思维链忠实性的反事实测试
translated_abstract: 思维链可能看起来很有说服力，但它可能无法忠实地反映模型的实际决策过程。尽管针对文本输入的思维链忠实性测量方法日益增多，但将这些方法应用于视觉输入并非易事。在这项工作中，我们将用于测量思维链忠实性的反事实方法家族——即反事实测试（CT）和相关性反事实测试（CCT）——适配到视觉输入上，并分别称之为vCT和vCCT。利用vCT和vCCT，我们在两个数据集上对八个最新的开源视觉语言模型进行了基准测试。我们的分析表明，思维链并不能可靠地追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据：即使移除某个物体导致预测发生巨大变化，思维链也可能忽略该物体；而当变化很小时，思维链却可能提及它。我们进一步发现，“先预测后解释”方式的解释与扰动的一致性更强。
tldr: 该论文提出将反事实测试方法（vCT和vCCT）适配到视觉输入，用于测量视觉语言模型思维链的忠实性，并发现思维链无法可靠追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts counterfactual test methods (vCT and vCCT) to visual inputs for measuring Chain-of-Thought faithfulness in Vision Language Models, revealing that CoTs do not reliably track the visual evidence that influences model predictions.
